name: People & Technology, Inc.
summary: People & Technology, Inc. engages in the manufacture of industrial film converting and semiconductor machinery. It operates through the Secondary Battery and Materials business divisions. The Secondary Battery division produces cathodes, anodes, and separators. The Materials division supplies special films for various display materials such as copper foil, optical film, and OCA films. The company was founded on December 29, 2003 and is headquartered in Gumi-si, South Korea.
